title: Forecasting Economically Significant Bitcoin Moves: A Multi-Scale TCN with Profit-Optimized Thresholds
abstract: arXiv:2608.26174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bitcoin's future fluctuations are a substantial concern for investments and risk management. Investors and financial institutions require accurate forecasts of these price movements to hedge and optimize portfolios. This study aims to answer the question of whether Bitcoin's price will rise beyond 5% within the next 7 days by utilizing on-chain, market, and sentiment data from February 2018 to December 2025. The proposed model consists of a multi-scale temporal convolutional network with InceptionTCN blocks, CNN channel attention, adaptive average pooling, and a pairwise ranking loss. Dilated convolutions with bottleneck and fusion layers are employed to efficiently capture features over horizons from 1 to 4 days. Given the class imbalance in the dataset, AUC is used instead of accuracy and other classification metrics to reflect the model's performance better. Subsequently, a profit-optimized decision threshold is also applied to align

translated_title: 预测具有经济意义的比特币走势：采用利润优化阈值的多尺度时间卷积网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26174v1 公告类型：新 摘要：比特币未来的波动对投资和风险管理构成重大关切。投资者和金融机构需要准确预测这些价格变动，以进行对冲和优化投资组合。本研究旨在通过利用2018年2月至2025年12月的链上、市场和情绪数据，回答比特币价格是否将在未来7天内上涨超过5%的问题。所提出的模型包括一个多尺度时间卷积网络，其中包含InceptionTCN块、CNN通道注意力、自适应平均池化和成对排名损失。采用带瓶颈和融合层的扩张卷积，以高效捕获1至4天时间跨度的特征。鉴于数据集中的类别不平衡，使用AUC代替准确率和其他分类指标，以更好地反映模型性能。随后，还应用了利润优化的决策阈值，以使预测与投资目标保持一致。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多尺度时间卷积网络模型，结合利润优化阈值，利用链上、市场和情绪数据预测比特币未来7天内是否上涨超过5%，并通过AUC和利润优化决策阈值提升经济实用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-scale temporal convolutional network with profit-optimized thresholds to forecast whether Bitcoin will rise over 5% within 7 days, using on-chain, market, and sentiment data, enhancing economic relevance via AUC and profit-aligned decisions.
